capabilities: Assign or clear a graph-category property on the current note via a modal
Define category keys, labels and paired dark/light colours in settings
Preview and apply category colours as native Graph colour groups
Explicitly remove tool-owned Graph colour rules via preview
Toggle Zen mode and typewriter scrolling while writing
disambiguation: Not an automatic classifier: categories are assigned deliberately one note at a time, and the README explicitly excludes automatic classification or content scans.
extras: Not yet published in the community plugin directory; manual installation into the plugin folder is required. Graph interop is probed only against Obsidian 1.14.5 desktop; mobile, detached windows and sync are explicitly not certified.
intentEvidence: The tool can also colour native Graph groups without replacing your theme.
problem: Obsidian's Graph view colour groups must be configured by hand with search queries, and there is no per-note workflow to assign a category and push its colour into the graph.

relations.evidence: Mounty and Omarchy remain standalone CSS themes with the same appearance at matching releases.
The old generator/0.4.1 companion in obsidian-omarchy-theme is preserved history, not the future plugin source

summary: Manual graph-category tool that assigns one category property per note and colours native Graph colour groups, with retained Zen and typewriter writing controls.
